$comment: App version and build number (Task 4A.2). Single source for the Android versionName/versionCode, the iOS MARKETING_VERSION/CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION and the version shown in the app. Increase build_number for every APK given to anyone (including the owner); never reuse one. After editing run `npm run version:bundle`. Separate from config/brand.json (the product name may change; versions do not restart).

history.label: MedLuma (DEV)
history.note: Assigned retroactively. The binary itself still says versionName 0.1.0-dev, versionCode 1; tell it apart from build 1 by its label and checksum.

history.label: MedLuma (DEV)
history.note: First build with version and build number embedded (versionName 0.1.2-dev, versionCode 3). Two APKs: universal (29.6 MB; apk_sha256) and ARM64-only (15.2 MB; apk_sha256_arm64).

history.label: MedLuma (DEV)
history.note: Scanner-first development build (versionName 0.1.3-dev, versionCode 4): on-device OCR (PaddleOCR PP-OCRv3 / ONNX Runtime 1.28.0, no telemetry) and barcodes (ZXing-cpp). ARM64 38.9 MB, universal 76.7 MB. DEVICE RESULT (owner, Pixel, 2026-11-12): every scan failed with "The photo could not be read" — fixed in build 5.

history.label: MedLuma (DEV)
history.note: Fixes the Pixel scan failure of build 4 (ZXing-cpp read() called with a null crop rectangle threw on every scan); text and barcodes now fail independently; development builds show the technical cause. DEVICE RESULT (owner's Pixel, 2026-11-12): no crash, but every photo gave '0 text lines' (barcode still decoded). Cause: the OCR dictionary was taken from ONNX Runtime's metadata API, which did not give the 6,623 entries the model needs, so every line decoded empty and was dropped.

history.label: MedLuma (DEV)
history.note: OCR dictionary read from the model file and checked against the model (a mismatch now fails loudly); PP-OCRv4 models; text read from a 3200-px copy of the photo (was 1600); extractor reads a known drug name without a strength and fixes S/5 after a drug name; development detail shows OCR counts. Two APKs: universal (79.3 MB; apk_sha256) and ARM64-only (41.4 MB; apk_sha256_arm64). DEVICE RESULT (owner's Pixel, 2026-11-12): a label was scanned successfully and the recall check completed with no matching recall; the result listed every FDA record checked in full, which led to the build 7 summary-first result screen. (Which label, Pixel model and Android version: not yet reported.)

history.label: MedLuma (DEV)
history.note: Summary-first result screen: record counts by group; limits and disclaimer directly below the result; matching, possibly matching and unreadable records always shown as cards with plain-language details; records the engine excluded are counted once each by a fixed primary-reason order and listed only on request. Categories and matching logic unchanged. Scanner unchanged from build 6. Two APKs: universal (79.3 MB; apk_sha256) and ARM64-only (41.4 MB; apk_sha256_arm64).
